method: The public channel uploads list was enumerated across four pages until no continuation remained. It returned 350 recorded videos and one old offline stream placeholder. The placeholder was excluded after Benjamin confirmed there is no livestream. All 350 recorded titles and thumbnails inspected, all 350 public embed metadata responses identify Math Videos, and ambiguous subjects resolved through sampled embedded playback and captions. Full videos were not watched end-to-end.
